top_signals.title: China’s Iron Ore Sway May Leave Japan a Price Taker: Woodmac
top_signals.summary: Japan and other major iron ore buyers risk becoming price takers as China’s state-backed purchasing company seeks greater influence over how the steelmaking ingredient is priced, according to consultant Wood Mackenzie Ltd.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
